dimensions.assessment: Applies to all manufacturers, wholesalers, suppliers, and retailers responsible for packaging covered wipes sold in the United States.
dimensions.evidence: The term ``covered entity'' means a manufacturer, wholesaler, supplier, individual or group of individuals, or retailer that is responsible for the labeling or retail packaging of a covered product

dimensions.assessment: Requires covered entities to alter product packaging to include specific warnings and symbols meeting high-contrast and sizing criteria.
dimensions.evidence: A covered entity shall label a covered product with the label notice and symbol, in accordance with subsections (b) and (c).

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal appropriations or revenue measures are included; enforcement uses existing FTC framework.
Imposes new federal labeling standards, authorizes FTC guidance and enforcement, and preempts all non-identical state labeling requirements.
dimensions.evidence: No State or political subdivision of a State may directly or indirectly establish or continue in effect... requirements with respect to the ``Do Not Flush'' labeling

dimensions.assessment: Enforces permanent labeling standards beginning one year after enactment for newly packaged or sold products.
dimensions.evidence: This section shall apply to a covered entity beginning on the date that is 1 year after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: Estimated implementation costs for businesses or the FTC are not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates nationwide 'Do Not Flush' labeling for certain premoistened disposable wipes, preempts state packaging laws, and gives enforcement powers to the FTC.
